snippet.title: DEFECT | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the world of #DEFECT.

Laws do not exist here, only The System does. It uses its Enforcers to drill into whatever is left of people’s humanity and maintain order, insuring Chaos Above All.

Wishlist today:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470010/DEFECT/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/defect-dde0e6 
GOG.com : https://www.gog.com/game/defect

Join future DEFECT Playtests: https://defect.firstlook.gg/
